meta.node_granularity: file, class, function and method nodes (not statements)
meta.edge_direction: source -> target. CONTAINS: parent to child. CALLS: caller to callee. IMPORTS: importing file to imported file. To find what a change can affect, walk CALLS edges BACKWARDS from the changed function (its callers).
meta.confidence: CALLS edges: 'sure' = the code text shows where the call goes; 'maybe' = depends on an assumption (e.g. self.method() could be overridden). Calls to Python itself or installed libraries, and calls the analysis could not trace, are counted in counts.calls_not_drawn and have no edge.

def demo_students(student_service):
    alice = student_service.create_student("Alice", "alice@example.com", "555-0101")
    say(1, f"created student {alice.student_id} ({alice.name})")
    bob = student_service.create_student("Bob", "bob@example.com", "555-0102")
    say(2, f"created student {bob.student_id} ({bob.name})")
    say(3, f"listed {len(student_service.list_all_students())} students")
    say(4, f"found student 1: {student_service.find_student_by_id(1).email}")
    student_service.update_student(1, "Alice Smith", "alice@school.org", "555-0199")
    say(5, f"updated student 1: {student_service.find_student_by_id(1).name}")
    try:
        student_service.create_student("Eve", "eve-without-at-sign", "555-0103")
    except ValueError as error:
        say(6, f"rejected bad email -> {error}")

def run_demo():
    reset_demo_data()
    student_service = StudentService(DEMO_FOLDER)
    course_service = CourseService(DEMO_FOLDER)
    enrollment_service = EnrollmentService(DEMO_FOLDER)

def delete_student(self, student_id):
        # Stop early (with an error) if the student does not exist.
        self.find_student_by_id(student_id)

        # Enrollments go first, so no enrollment points to a missing student.
        self.enrollment_repository.remove_enrollments_for_student(student_id)

        # Now it is safe to delete the student itself.
        self.repository.remove_student(student_id)
